wholeGoal.title: Siliconöle, Siliconharze und Siliconkautschuke strukturbezogen erklären
wholeGoal.titleEn: Explain silicone oils, resins and rubbers through structure
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann an ausgewählten Beispielen die Herstellung und den Bau von Siliconölen, Siliconharzen und Siliconkautschuken beschreiben und ihre Eigenschaften sowie passende Anwendungen aus Kettenstruktur, Funktionalität der Ausgangsstoffe und Vernetzungsgrad erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe the manufacture and molecular constitution of selected silicone oils, silicone resins and silicone rubbers, and explain their properties and appropriate applications using chain structure, starting-material functionality and degree of crosslinking.

chemicalAndCoverageReasons: Both complete cases cover manufacture, molecular constitution, properties and uses for oil, resin and rubber, not only PDMS oil/rubber. M/D/T functionality is tied to network topology. Hydrolysis of dichlorodimethylsilane needs2H2O and yields2HCl; alkoxy-trifunctional hydrolysis needs3H2O and yields3EtOH; silanol condensation separately yieldsH2O. Si valence and group accounting are correct.

Independent changed evidence occurs in the increasedT network selection and the specifically moisture-curing system moved to dry conditions. Neither unchanged softness nor universal moisture/temperature guarantees is accepted. Conditional phrasing for inhibited dry cure avoids claiming every silicone route requires moisture.
Two12point rubrics require all4expectations, including balanced formation and separately justified transfer. Cases supply all needed information and do not claim actual synthesis.
atomicityReason: Manufacture/functionality→siloxane chain/network→properties/use is one bounded explanatory relation across three deliberately compared families. Oil/resin/rubber are necessary comparative exemplars of that relation, not unrelated competences or a new nanotechnology task. No independent capability needs splitting off.
memoryReason: The assessed work is explaining and transferring functionality/network relations from supplied structures and properties. Compact names and reaction facts can be reconstructed from the provided material; a separate mandatory recall deck is not justified.
kindReason: The whole goal is an assessable school-chemistry content competence under the explicitly bounded source/programme condition; it is neither orientation, memory, assessment terminal nor structural area. This is own scientific classification, not a claim that an authoritative currentkind ledger already exists.
sourceConditionScience: HB physical34 optional Vertiefungen explicitly lists manufacture/structure/properties/applications and allthree families. This source supports the bounded whole new body only in a selected silicone deepening for eligible GK/LK, not an unconditional course entitlement.
prerequisiteScience: Current2652 structure/linkage→property/use is a relevant foundation. New silicone-specific reactions are part of this learning objective and supplied in the cases, not evidence that unrelated whole nanotechnology/food competence is needed. No whole-scope acquisition closure is granted.

wholeGoal.title: Organische Farbmittel nach Kriterien einteilen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Classify organic colourants using explicit criteria
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann ausgewählte organische Farbmittelklassen anhand ausdrücklich benannter Kriterien vorstellen und gegebene Vertreter nachvollziehbar einteilen. Sie berücksichtigt dabei Azofarbstoffe und mindestens zwei weitere ausgewählte Farbstoffklassen und erläutert, wie Einteilungen nach Molekülstruktur, Löslichkeit, Herkunft, Färbemethode oder Verwendung unterschiedliche Zuordnungskriterien nutzen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can introduce selected classes of organic colourants using explicitly named criteria and classify supplied representatives transparently. They include azo dyes and at least two further selected dye classes and explain how classification by molecular structure, solubility, origin, dyeing method or use applies different criteria.

chemicalAndCoverageReasons: The two complete classification collections each include azo, triarylmethane and glycosylated flavylium/anthocyanin examples. The central triaryl cation [C(C6H4–NMe2)3]+ and azo motif are chemically usable class features; the target does not demand complete atom-resolved structural drawings or synthesis mechanisms for these extra classes.

Tasks distinguish allfive axes. Supplied medium-specific soluble/dispersed states avoid a false universal water-solubility rule; synthetic versus extracted anthocyanin separates origin from unchanged structure. P→Pprime changes soluble application/method/use without changing azo class or synthetic origin.

Missing textile-method information must be identified, not invented; indicator is classified as use rather than a new molecular class. Both rubrics assess classification with reasons and inference limits, not a list of names or natural=harmless.
atomicityReason: This is one assessable operation: choose an explicit criterion and classify representatives consistently. Multiple axes and at leastthree classes are coherent comparison/transfer operands of that operation. Azo synthesis is a distinct source duty and is not hidden inside this atom.
memoryReason: Criterion-based assignment using supplied cards requires discrimination and explanation. Bare recall of class labels would be insufficient, and no independent compulsory memory item is established by the whole goal.
kindReason: The whole goal is an assessable school-chemistry content competence under the explicitly bounded source/programme condition; it is neither orientation, memory, assessment terminal nor structural area. This is own scientific classification, not a claim that an authoritative currentkind ledger already exists.
sourceConditionScience: RP physical47 clause003 provides at leasttwo further classes with mechanisms explicitly unnecessary. Whole classification uses the adjacent Fundamentum clause001 plus selectedAdditum breadth, with azo mechanism clause002 retained separately. Clause003 alone is not the whole broader classification source. RP6.2 Additum is selectedWP/Leistungsfach, technicallyLK only here; not a GK/default grant.
prerequisiteScience: Current7990387d supports functional-group classification. New azo/triaryl/flavylium criteria are actually supplied and are learned here; no current azo-synthesis mechanism prerequisite is required for class assignment. Full neighbour-partner union is not approved.

wholeGoal.title: Polyaddition am Urethanbildungsmechanismus erklären
wholeGoal.titleEn: Explain polyaddition through the urethane-formation mechanism
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den Mechanismus der Polyaddition am Beispiel der Reaktion von Hydroxy- und Isocyanatgruppen auf Teilchenebene erklären, dabei Elektronenpaarverschiebungen und Protonenübertragung bis zur Urethanbindung darstellen und die wiederholte Gruppenreaktion bifunktioneller Ausgangsstoffe zur Kettenbildung ohne Abspaltung eines kleinen Moleküls verknüpfen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the mechanism of polyaddition at particle level using the reaction of hydroxyl and isocyanate groups, represent electron-pair shifts and proton transfer leading to the urethane linkage, and connect repeated group reactions of bifunctional starting materials to chain formation without elimination of a small molecule.

chemicalAndCoverageReasons: Both full cases require actual electron-pair origin/destination, valence-correct zwitterionic representation, B/BHplus-mediated proton transfer, neutral urethane product and a continuable chain with at leasttwo links. AlcoholO attacks the electrophilicNCO carbon, C=N pi electrons move toN; the formal Nminus/Oplus(H) intermediate has zero net charge and valid atom valences.

The relay removesO-boundH with its bond pair returning toO; Nminus receivesH fromBHplus while B–H electrons return toB. All substituents/atoms are retained; no water is eliminated in this stipulated dryOH/NCO addition. The material honestly calls this a simplified formal model, not a unique or dominant microscopic kinetic path.

Case1 changes a subset of diol to monofunctional ethanol at equalOH count; case2 changes substituents and replaces all diol to give end-capped bisurethane rather than a long chain. Error diagnosis separates mechanism from a bare product equation. Equal group count cannot substitute for bifunctional connectivity.
atomicityReason: The local electron-pair/proton sequence and its repeatability are one coherent polyaddition mechanism competence. Extending the same local reaction to chain formation is necessary to distinguish polyaddition from a single adduct; no independent laboratory execution or kinetics skill is bundled.
memoryReason: Mechanistic electron accounting, atom/charge conservation and functionality transfer are reconstruction skills. The supplied polarity/helper/structures support derivation; rote arrow or urethane-formula recall is not independently required.
kindReason: The whole goal is an assessable school-chemistry content competence under the explicitly bounded source/programme condition; it is neither orientation, memory, assessment terminal nor structural area. This is own scientific classification, not a claim that an authoritative currentkind ledger already exists.
sourceConditionScience: RP physical65 explicitly offers Mechanismus der Polyaddition under optional Vertiefungs-/Verzahnungsmöglichkeiten spanning course columns. A selected urethane example is scientifically legitimate; it cannot be turned into universalGK/LK compulsory duty or confused with the optional neighbouring list of specialty plastics.
prerequisiteScience: Current7990387d alcohol/group classification and448815cc bond/electron-pair foundation are relevant. Isocyanate polarity and proton helper are supplied and explained as part of the new mechanism target. A separate oldLKf947 application goal is not silently widened or treated as an existing full elementary-mechanism witness.

wholeGoal.title: Filmfixierung durch Silberbromid-Komplexbildung erklären
wholeGoal.titleEn: Explain film fixing through silver-bromide complex formation
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann das Fixieren eines Schwarz-Weiß-Films auf Stoff- und Teilchenebene erläutern, indem sie das Auflösen des verbliebenen Silberbromids durch Bildung löslicher Silber-Ligand-Komplexe erklärt und es vom verbleibenden metallischen Silberbild sowie von Belichtung und Entwicklung unterscheidet.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the fixing of a black-and-white film at substance and particle levels by accounting for the dissolution of residual silver bromide through soluble silver–ligand complexes and distinguishing it from the remaining metallic-silver image, exposure and development.

chemicalAndCoverageReasons: Both full cases correctly distinguish residualAgBr(s),Ag(I) in the soluble thiosulfato complex, and the retainedAg(0) image. Overall AgBr+2S2O3^2−→[Ag(S2O3)2]^3−+Br− conserves Ag1Br1S4O6 and charge−4;Ag stays+I in fixing, unlike developer reduction.

Case1 needs2.00mmol free ligand for1.00mmolAgBr and leaves4.00mmol from6.00. Case2 permits atmost0.60mmolAgBr removal from1.20mmol free ligand, leavingatleast0.20mmol from0.80 in the explicitly restrictedbis-complex capacity model. This is an upper-bound stoichiometric capacity, not a universal real-speciation or kinetics claim.

Water-only/light exposure and exhausted-versus-freshbath transfers require independent dissolution/stability reasoning. Removed liquid still contains complexed silver; no false silver-free or experimental/disposal evidence is granted.
atomicityReason: Substance/particle explanation, balanced complex formation and preservation of the metallic image are connected parts of the single film-fixing phenomenon. Exposure/development are necessary contrasts, not an extra demand for their full mechanisms or a practical experimental protocol.
memoryReason: Charge/atom balance, supplied ligand ratio and explanation of solution equilibrium are reasoning with provided material. The whole target does not establish a separate hard-memory requirement.
kindReason: The whole goal is an assessable school-chemistry content competence under the explicitly bounded source/programme condition; it is neither orientation, memory, assessment terminal nor structural area. This is own scientific classification, not a claim that an authoritative currentkind ledger already exists.
sourceConditionScience: SN physical41/printed29 GK11 Wahlbereich1 explicitly requires knowledge of fixing through AgBr dissolution by complex formation. The adjacent practicalsilver-halide/fixing experiment and developer experiment remain separate whole duties. This paper explanation does not clear either. Only selectedGKphotography scope, notLK or universaldefault.
prerequisiteScience: Current448815cc supports bonding and ions; orientation is no chemistry knowledge certificate. Complexation, dissolution and image distinctions are the content taught here and fully specified in the cases. No prior EDTA titration or silver-nanoparticle competence is required. Fullview acquisition remains separately checked.

wholeGoal.title: Reaktionsbedingungen der Kunststoffsynthesen vergleichen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Compare reaction conditions of polymer syntheses
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann an ausgewählten Beispielen die Reaktionsbedingungen von radikalischer Kettenpolymerisation, Polykondensation und Polyaddition vergleichen und die Unterschiede anhand der jeweiligen Gruppenreaktion sowie geeigneter Angaben zu Initiierung oder Katalyse, Temperatur und erforderlicher Reaktionsführung begründen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can compare the reaction conditions of radical chain polymerization, polycondensation and polyaddition using selected examples and justify differences through the corresponding group reaction and suitable information about initiation or catalysis, temperature and required reaction control.

chemicalAndCoverageReasons: Each full case actually compares radicalchainpolymerization, polycondensation and polyaddition across group/linkage changes, initiation/catalysis, temperature and reaction control. The supplied numbers are example windows, not universal class constants.

Case1 distinguishes radicalstarter generation/oxygen inhibition, polyester condensation with productwater removal, and dryOH/NCO addition with heat control. A catalyst changes approach rate without shifting equilibriumK at fixedT; it is not the stoichiometrically consumed radicalstarter.

Case2 uses light-initiated methacrylate polymerization and20C interfacial diamine/diacidchloride condensation producingHCl plus urethane addition. Darkness, omittedHCl scavenger, and moisture have distinct chemical causes. The base is correctly a consumedacid scavenger, not automatically a regeneratedcatalyst. Temperature alone cannot classify a reaction.

The changed monomer/initiator/condensation partners force genuine full three-route transfer and refute fixedhotcondensation or universalcatalyst rules. Both rubrics separately grade allfour facets; no practical synthesis is claimed.
atomicityReason: This is one comparison skill over three previously learned routes. Their individual mechanisms are existing prerequisites; comparing process conditions is not three unrelated new mechanism lessons and does not absorb the separate monomer/polymer-structure comparison or laboratory-execution duties.
memoryReason: Comparison is derived from given reaction examples and conditions, supported by existing mechanism prerequisites. No universal temperature/catalyst table or memorized recipe is legitimate; no new memory deck is needed.
kindReason: The whole goal is an assessable school-chemistry content competence under the explicitly bounded source/programme condition; it is neither orientation, memory, assessment terminal nor structural area. This is own scientific classification, not a claim that an authoritative currentkind ledger already exists.
sourceConditionScience: TH physical58/printed53 right-column additional elevatedrequirement compares reactionconditions for allthreeprecedingroutes. This is a compulsoryeA/LK comparison operator, not optionalGK, a rate experiment or genericlabcluster. BothTHcarriers must retain identicalcomponent meaning. Neighbour monomer/polymerstructure comparisons and makingaplastic remain separate.
prerequisiteScience: Existing6ebradical mechanism,9b94polycondensation andf947polyaddition are substantively appropriate for the comparison. Their whole currentbodies/requires are retained. Presence of anedge or a sourceword is not proof of wholeview acquisition or fullsource union.
